title: Figure 4. Filter Factor Results for Representative Configurations of Atlas
description: Line graph of "Filtered Failure Probability" (0 to 0.12) versus "Sample Index (newer ->)" (0 to 160) for filter factors F = 0.97, 0.98 and 0.99, showing sawtooth curves that jump at failures and decay between them. Text below discusses choosing F, with RTI recommending 0.98 as the best estimate for 45 SW/SE launch-area risk analyses.
